title: Very small and uncomfortable
text: Very small and uncomfortable. I got this when it was on sale. It’s very small for three people. And the quality is very bad. It’s very uncomfortable to use. It’s definitely easy to assemble but still regret getting it. And I wish I didn’t go with this cheap product

product_metadata.title: Lifestyle Solutions Harrington Sofa, Grey
features: COMFORTABLE SOFA: Our button-tufted rolled-arm Harrington Sofa has thick, plush seat cushions for the utmost in comfort and style. It's perfect for lounging in front of the television or a roaring fire.
MODERN STYLE: Chic and minimalist, this sofa’s button tufted back and tapered square faux wooden legs add to its sleek profile.
HASSLE-FREE: Setup is easy with our tool-free assembly.
LIFE-PROOF UPHOLSTERY: Upholstered in premium, easy to care for fabric
DIMENSIONS: 80.3'' W x 32'' D x 32.68'' H
description: The Lifestyle Solutions Harrington button-tufted sofa will be the center of your design theme in your living room. Our thoughtfully designed sofa gives charm and bespoke elegance to any design aesthetic and is a sophisticated, comfy seating option for you and your family. With its craftsmanship and attention to detail, you can be assured of the quality and be proud to have the Harrington in your home. This comfy couch with rolled arms is ideal for someone who's just starting out and needs apartment furniture. Whether you live in a studio or a loft, the Harrington will fit right in and add a touch of luxury. The Harrington sofa is easy to assemble, and no tools are required. Simply click it together, and the sofa is ready for stylish comfort and enjoyment. It has a heavy-duty wood frame and offers durable support. There are plenty of couches and sofas out there, but the Harrington fits any living room style: modern, traditional, and contemporary. If you're looking for a mini couch for your basement entertainment room or a small sofa for a home theater, this is the ideal sofa. And if you've dreamed of turning your bedroom into a luxury hotel suite, this bedroom sofa will make your room an oasis of comfort and relaxation. With Lifestyle Solutions, your design dreams are limitless.

details.Care instructions: Vacuum the seat cushions, backrest, arms, and under the seat cushions regularly., Avoid using strong chemicals when cleaning, Keep out of direct sunlight to prevent fading, Wipe Clean with Dry Cloth
details.Special Feature: Button Tufted, Plastic faux wood textured legs, Piping around arms, Tool free assembly, Curved arm
